scope: Conditional original-JP three-actor handoff. Actual ROM footage, explanatory diagrams, on-screen commentary and original instrumental music. No spoken narration. Setup grants remain explicit; no complete gameplay route is claimed.
badge: Original JP replay / supplied setup / A released
positionLegend: M Movement / C Collision / G Stored Graphics
sourceStepConvention: Native bridge1 completes top update128; bridge2 completes129; bridge3 completes130; bridge4 completes131. Bridges25/26 have no camera observations. Bridge27 is the first checked Area2 arrival.

segments.title: Three actors, three different jobs
lines: A frozen shell, an enlarged black Bob-omb, and a Crazy Box work together.
The original Japanese game reaches a useful displaced Area 2 spawn.
segments.footer: High entry, actor positions and copied Bob state are supplied. This demonstrates a local handoff, not a complete gameplay route.

segments.title: The supplied airborne starting point
lines: The test places airborne Mario at Y 19900, ten units above the shell.
His ground-slide action is not supplied. The game must create it.
segments.footer: Initial FREEFALL at (-1960,19900,-1230); horizontal speed 0, vertical speed -16. High shell delivery remains a setup grant.

segments.title: Shell contact, then Z in the same update
lines: Shell contact mounts Mario; Z cancels riding into a butt slide.
The slide's floor alignment puts Movement on the real spinning top.
segments.footer: One Z update, then neutral controls. M=C.Y 1809.207; G.Y 19900. This immediate alignment is not a long visible fall.

segments.title: Three positions to watch
lines: M is Movement. C is the Mario object's Collision position.
G is Stored Graphics: gfx.pos, not the visibly drawn model.
segments.footer: Diagrams show stored coordinates, not the rendered pose. G is always a labelled coordinate marker, never a model-placement claim.

segments.title: The rotating top separates M and C
segments.tag: INSIDE TOP UPDATE 129 / EXPLANATORY TOP VIEW
lines: The top moves Movement sideways before Mario's actor interactions.
Collision still uses the earlier position when the game checks the Bob.
segments.footer: The enlarged Bob reaches old C while sitting near shifted M. Radius 91+37 registers; stock 65+37 misses this exact placement.

segments.title: Bob supplies the earlier shove
segments.tag: TOP UPDATE 129 / SUPPLIED ACTOR POSITION, NATIVE RESPONSE
lines: The Bob pushes Mario toward the low pad's footprint.
Mario stays in butt slide at Y 1839.447, with no platform carried forward.
segments.footer: Bob position is supplied before 129. Its callback and fuse remain live; its radius changes normally after this useful contact.

segments.title: First save the low floor
segments.tag: START OF TOP UPDATE 130 / DIRECT ROM QUERY CHECK
lines: A fresh floor lookup saves height 768 while Movement is still high.
This happens before the Crazy Box's shove. The order matters.
segments.footer: Native hook confirms the initial query and saved cache 768. A shove's separate floor check does not overwrite Mario's cache.

segments.title: Crazy Box supplies the final shove
segments.tag: TOP UPDATE 130 / FINAL ACTOR POSITION CUT
lines: The Crazy Box now pushes Mario farther sideways.
Bob and Box act on different updates, not as two same-type pushes at once.
segments.footer: Normal interaction ordering chooses the Crazy Box here. Bob remains present. There is no collision-list or floor-cache edit.

segments.title: Save high G, then snap low
segments.tag: INSIDE TOP UPDATE 130 / STORE, STOP AND ALIGN
lines: The stopped ground step saves high coordinates in G.
Floor alignment snaps Movement to 768; Collision also finishes low.
segments.footer: M=C (-2200.002,768,-1075.004); G.Y 1839.447. Gap 1071.447. The top underside stops the quarter; cached 768 survives.

segments.title: Low warp contact, high floor retry
segments.tag: TOP UPDATE 131 / ACCEPTED WARP AND TOP CAPTURE
lines: Low Collision overlaps the real warp.
The failed floor lookup retries at Stored Graphics and selects the top.
segments.footer: Warp 64 is accepted; floor and platform name top 61 at Y 1914.855. The floor query is high; the real warp remains low.

segments.title: The top reference survives
lines: The recorded Area 1 boundaries retain the top as Mario's platform.
That retained reference is needed for the later spawning displacement.
segments.footer: Two transition camera observations are unavailable. We disclose the gap; first Area 2 coordinates come from the native log.

segments.title: A useful Area 2 arrival
segments.tag: USEFUL SPAWN / CHECKED LOG + LATER JP REPLAY
lines: The original Japanese ROM reaches (365.593,5500,-1096.803).
The ordinary upper-warp arrival is (0,5500,256).
segments.footer: First-arrival coordinates come from the checked native log. Later replay images may show movement. Diagram compares spawn points.

segments.title: Without the final Crazy Box
lines: Omitting only the final Crazy Box still makes a gap and fresh floor 768.
But it reaches the ordinary spawn without capturing the top.
segments.footer: Both runs accept the warp. The control keeps the live Bob and its later nudge; only the final Crazy Box placement is omitted.

segments.title: The handoff works; joining the route is open
lines: A black Bob-omb can replace the Buddy's local job in this revised setup.
Joining Mario's entry, actor delivery and timing through play is still open.
segments.footer: Supplied: shell spawn/fake-pickup pointer/high HOLP, copied Bob state, high Mario/shell and actor positions. No later Mario edits.
